key_insight: A continuous-time policy gradient framework learns from discrete observations while providing exponential convergence for an entropy-regularized policy flow.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports model-free control of stochastic dynamical systems without requiring known dynamics.
method: Derive a performance difference lemma and policy gradients for randomized and parametrized policies.
Bound discrete-update error contributions from critic estimation, policy regression, and learning step size.
Use PhiBE to construct a surrogate continuous-time generator for on-policy and off-policy actor-critic learning.
evidence_signal: Experiments on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot evaluate performance and stability with known and data-driven dynamics.
watch_item: Exponential convergence applies to the regularized policy flow; practical discrete updates remain sensitive to critic error, policy-regression error, and step size.
paper_title: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
